purpose: Final assessment of eight-stock pricing methods, neural and classical. No training, tuning or model selection may use these cases or their references.
conventions: Strike fixed at 100. Time in years; rates, dividend yields and volatilities are decimals. Vega and correlation sensitivities per unit decimal change; theta is calendar time per year; rho per unit rate.

domain_constraints.weights: On the simplex with every weight >= 0.04, uniform: w = 0.04 + 0.68 * D with D ~ Dirichlet(1, ..., 1) (eight ones).
domain_constraints.correlation: Three-factor matrices R = B B' + diag(1 - |b_i|^2): each stock's loadings b_i = (market, style 1, style 2) with market uniform on [0.2, 0.9] and each style loading uniform on [-0.5, 0.5], a row redrawn while |b_i|^2 > 0.95. Every entry then lies in [-0.46, 0.95] and the smallest eigenvalue is at least 0.05. Uniform entries with rejection, as in the four-stock protocol, accept about 1 draw in 20,000 for eight stocks, and the matrices they accept are untypical of stock correlations.

sampling.latin_hypercube: scipy.stats.qmc.LatinHypercube(d=33, seed=seed + split offset): columns 1-26 scale to the box parameters, columns 27-33 are seven uniforms whose sorted spacings (0, u(1), ..., u(7), 1) are a uniform Dirichlet(1, ..., 1) draw for the weights.
sampling.correlation_stream: numpy.random.Generator(PCG64(seed + 100 + split offset)); per case, stock by stock, three uniforms (market, style 1, style 2) scaled to their ranges, the stock's three redrawn while |b_i|^2 > 0.95.
sampling.options: Calls and puts alternate within each split, starting with a call.
sampling.replacement_draws: No case is replaced: RQMC always returns an estimate, and a case above the error target is kept and flagged.

short_maturity.reason: remaining life below the training domain; tau = 0.005 + 0.045 * (the tau column's uniform)

extrapolation.reason: one parameter outside the training domain
extrapolation.stock_rotation: For the v-th value of a group (v = 0, 1), case k (0-3) moves stock 2k + v + 1, so the two values of a group move all eight stocks.
extrapolation.notes: A weight value goes to the affected stock and the other weights are rescaled proportionally to sum to 1. A correlation value fixes the pair listed for that case (pairs 1-4 for the first value, 5-8 for the second). The other loading rows are a domain draw; with u the unit direction of the pair's first row and u2 the unit vector of the second row's component orthogonal to u, the pair's rows become sqrt(h) u and sqrt(h) (a u + sqrt(1 - a^2) u2) with communality h = max(0.95, |value|) and a = value / h, so the pair's entry is the value and the matrix stays a factor matrix. The smallest eigenvalue is checked to be >= 0.01.

cases.name: negative_equicorrelation_call
cases.note: close to the smallest equicorrelation -1/7 for which eight stocks stay valid; smallest eigenvalue 1 - 7 * 0.135 = 0.055

cases.name: low_eigenvalue_call
cases.note: 0.95 * cos(a_i - a_j) + 0.05 * I with angles 0, 12, ..., 84 degrees: all entries positive, smallest eigenvalue 0.05

reference.method: Conditional estimator of src/pricing (one Gaussian factor in closed form, direction "volatility") with replicated scrambled-Sobol RQMC over the seven residual factors and the geometric control variate (rqmc_estimate); analytic conditional Deltas and spot Hessian; central common-random-number bumps for vega, theta, rho and correlation sensitivities. Tensor Gauss-Hermite, the four-stock reference, needs n^7 points and is not feasible.
reference.acceptance: Climb the points per replicate until the price standard error is at most the target (currency units, strike 100); keep the first level that meets it. A case still above the target at the last level keeps that level and is flagged; no case is replaced.
reference.seeds: Production run seed = protocol seed + 10000 + case index; cross-check run seed = protocol seed + 20000 + case index.

cross_checks.independent_run: A second rqmc_estimate at the accepted level with its own seed; z = (second - reference) / sqrt(se_1^2 + se_2^2) per quantity; |z| > 5 is flagged for a look.
cross_checks.equal_direction: direction "equal" at the accepted level with the production seed; z against the reference as above.
cross_checks.bump_halving: bump_scale 0.5 at the accepted level with the production seed (common random numbers); maximum relative change of the bumped quantities.
cross_checks.relative_floors: Relative differences divide by max(|reference|, floor) with floor 1e-7 for Gammas and 1e-4 otherwise.
cross_checks.use: Recorded only; never used to change a reference.

separation.metric: For a test case and a development contract, the largest over parameters of |difference| / domain width (moneyness, tau, volatility, rate, dividend, weight and the 28 correlations; widths from the training domain). The reported separation is the minimum over all pairs.
separation.duplicates: No test case may equal a development contract (same option and all contract fields within 1e-9).

rules: Train, tune and select models only on data generated with other seeds; never on these cases or references.
Development and training data must use seeds other than 20261017 and its offsets and must keep a positive minimum distance from every test case under the separation metric; report that distance.
Before evaluating any model on these cases, freeze its checkpoint hash, settings and the evaluation protocol.
Report every method on every split; do not drop cases after seeing results.
Every reference carries a standard error; report method errors next to the reference error, and do not read differences below about three reference standard errors as differences.
Once any method is evaluated here, the cases are observed; later model changes need a new test set.
